target: The Wii Menu (system menu 4.3, widescreen) as rendered by the Dolphin emulator at 1920x1080
sources: The user's own reference walk of the target (Dolphin, 2026-11-11), measured from a screen recording mapped to 1920x1080; measurements only, nothing kept

YouTube, Laura Freeman, "My Wii Menu (Via Dolphin Emulator)", https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LIto3W_PZPc (1080p): the channel grid at 8 s and 98-106 s, a page turn at 102.03-102.40 s; frames read in the browser at 1/30 s steps, nothing downloaded
Layout only: no channel art, icons, sounds, fonts or names from the target are used

measurements.grid: channels 382 x 212 from (162, 93) on a 405 x 232 pitch, four columns at 16:9 (more at the same size on wider screens); the neighbouring pages peek at the sides
measurements.bar: a light panel (#d0d1d8) whose top edge is at y ~795 at the sides and dips to ~900 in a centred notch; round buttons about 170 across centred on (174, 922) and (1746, 924)
measurements.clock: large, light grey, in the notch (centre ~y 845); the date darker under it, centred on y ~973
measurements.page turn: one page slides in about 450 ms, ease-out
measurements.open: about 870 ms: the screen dims, the channel grows into a framed card, its content fades in, then the name tab
measurements.hover: a thick cyan glow round the channel and its name in a white pill under it; no zoom
